china-1929-30:p0969_3.rationale: Semi-monthly man-labour hours across several crops (wheat, cotton, soybeans, kaoliang, millet, sweet potatoes, tobacco) on a Shantung farm survey; a statistical table of farm labour by crop.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for farm labour inputs or peasant labour time; crop-production is an approximate fit.

china-1929-30:p0970_1.rationale: Man-labour hours per mow by half-month for six crops in Weihsien; statistical farm labour table organised by crop.
review_questions: Propose a tag for farm labour input or peasant labour time.

china-1929-30:p0971_1.rationale: Counts of surveyed farms by town on the Chengtu Plain; a sample distribution, not tenure or production. No existing tag covers farm survey sampling.
review_questions: Propose a tag for farm surveys or sample distribution.

china-1929-30:p0971_2.rationale: Farms, percentage and acreage by operator type (owner, part-owner, renter) on 50 Chengtu farms; directly concerns tenure.

china-1929-30:p0972_1.rationale: Paid and unpaid labour costs and income from labour for renters, part-owners and owners on surveyed farms. Costs of farm labour are not wages in a standard sense and no tag fits well.
review_questions: Propose a tag for farm labour costs or farm income; wages is a doubtful fit as it mixes paid and unpaid labour.

china-1929-30:p0978_1.rationale: Fee schedules for trademark registration, re-registration and assignment; quantitative fee amounts under industrial-property registration.

china-1929-30:p0986_1.rationale: Fees prescribed under the Nationalist trademark regulations (Arts. 34-35) for registration, assignment, oppositions and copies; monetary amounts are the substance.

china-1929-30:p0987_1.rationale: Article 36 classification of goods into 65 classes for trademark registration; purely textual descriptions of goods categories without quantities.

china-1929-30:p0994_1.rationale: Numbered list of subjects of National Economic Conference taxation resolutions (revenue demarcation, transit duties, tariff autonomy, budget); purely textual.

china-1929-30:p0994_2.rationale: Textual schedule classifying revenue sources and expenditures as national or provincial, with new and existing taxes listed; no quantities.
